name: ImGuiWindow.InputText
description: Appends a single-line ImGui InputText element to an ImGuiWindow and stores the callback. The initial text is copied into a fixed 256-byte text buffer. When the input changes, the callback receives the current string.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Optional initial text. When omitted or nil, the input starts with an empty string.

parameters.name: onChange
parameters.description: Callback invoked with the current string after an edit event.
